# Noir stickman — Style Prompt

> Illustrated night stories: compact figures with matte-black round heads, small cream-white eyes and a line mouth, black hands and legs, and one bold hoodie colour, act in layered full-colour city sets. Deep plum shadows fill the frame; warm amber comes only from lamps, shop windows and doorways, and it catches the figures as a thin rim on one side. A white title sits in the upper left for the whole film, and big uppercase captions light up word by word at the bottom.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

A **short film with one clear action per shot**: walking toward a light, a close-up of the eyes darting at a closed shutter, turning to a glowing window, an object changing hands across a counter. The mood is curious and quiet, a small mystery that resolves. It suits stories with a turn (late night, a problem, a found answer), a shop told as a scene, a creator's anecdote, a lesson told as a moment.

Not a cartoon explainer (no white paper, no icons, no diagrams), not glossy 3D toys or realistic people, not a neon cyberpunk look (light is warm and practical: lamps, windows), not a talking head: the figure acts and reacts, it never presents.

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Figure**: a big matte-black round head (about a quarter of the height) on a short black neck, two small cream-white eye shapes with black pupils, a short cream line mouth (flat, small smile, frown, open grin); cream brows only when worried. A hoodie in one bold colour with a darker hood, kangaroo pocket and two cream drawstrings; black mitten hands, black legs as thick strokes, black flat feet. Each figure gets a second copy of its shapes in amber, shifted a few pixels toward the light and drawn behind: the rim light.
- **Sets**: flat angular shapes in layers: a plum night-sky gradient, a far skyline with a scatter of small amber windows, near buildings, a pavement with a few perspective seams, a darker road at the bottom, and a dark foreground object (a lamppost, a bin) for the truck. Rolling shutters as fine horizontal lines, bookshelves as rows of slim rects.
- **Light**: lamp glows and pools are radial amber gradients; windows and doors are vertical gradients from pale light to amber, with dark frames; light spills onto the pavement as a fading trapezoid. A soft oval vignette is drawn once over every shot.
- No textures that move, no blur, no outlines on the sets.

## 3. Colour logic

- The night belongs to the look and stays put: plum sky (`--langit-1`, `--langit-2`), buildings (`--gedung-jauh`, `--gedung`, `--dinding`), pavement (`--trotoar`, `--aspal`), warm interiors (`--dinding-hangat`, `--kayu`), light (`--amber`, `--cahaya`), figures (`--tinta`, `--krem`). A light brand does not turn the night day.
- The brand dresses the hero: the hoodie is `--utama`; book covers and props mix `--utama` and `--aksen` into the wood. A second character wears a look-owned colour (`--kardigan`) so the hero stays the only brand colour.
- The upper-left title is `--putih`; captions are `--krem` with a thick `--tinta` outline, and the word being spoken turns `--amber`.
- The closing card is `--latar-2` with a `--utama` top edge, `--teks` name, `--teks-redup` contact and a `--utama` hours pill with `--teks-di-utama`.
- Rule: amber marks where the story goes; the brightest thing in each shot is the answer.

## 4. Type

- **Title** (whole film, upper left): `--font-judul` uppercase in two lines with a thin white rule on the left, the first line medium 44–48 px, the second bold 62–66 px at 1080 high (52 / 74 px on a 1080-wide vertical). A condensed grotesque (Oswald by default; Bebas Neue suits).
- **Captions**: `--font-judul` bold uppercase, 84–88 px at 1080 high (104–110 px vertical), one semantic phrase of two to four words per cue, one or two lines, centred near the bottom, outline about 0.12 em, a small hard shadow. No panel behind them.
- Card text in `--font-isi` (Inter) for contact lines, 28–32 px.

## 5. Motion quality

- **Shot length** 2.9–3.1 s, cut on the end of the action; endings hold 2 s or more.
- **Walk**: two-pose stride at 0.4 s per step (`sine.inOut`), about 200 px per second at 1080 high; a stop settles into a slumped or turned pose in 0.45–0.5 s.
- **Faces**: pupils dart in 0.3 s and hold 0.4 s; brows fade in 0.2 s; mouths change at the middle of a move. The mouth never lip-syncs.
- **Hand-offs**: an object travels between hands in 0.45 s `power2.inOut`, the receiving arm moves with it.
- **Captions**: a phrase enters with a small pop (scale 0.92 → 1 in 0.13 s, `back.out(3)`), words light amber in turn over the first 80 % of the cue, the last word stays lit until the next cue.
- **Camera**: always a slow move: a push to 1.05–1.06 over the shot (`power1.inOut`), a settle from 1.08 to 1 on the ending, or a truck with layers at about 0.25×, 1× and 3×.

## 6. Camera grammar

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Wide street, slow push | alone, at night, something missing | the hook; the late hour; a need |
| Close-up on the black head, eyes darting | worry, searching | the problem; a closed door; a "now what?" |
| Layered truck toward a lit window | hope found | the fact; the turn; the shop revealed |
| Two-shot over a lit counter | help, exchange | the offer; a service; a recommendation |
| Settle out on the lit storefront | arrival, a place to come back to | the call to action; the name; the hours |

## 7. Native moves

- **Walking to the lamp.** A lone figure crosses a plum street toward a lamp's pool of amber and slumps. *Fits content like:* a student who needs a book tonight; a rider with a flat tyre; a creator out of ideas at midnight; a story's lonely start.
- **Eyes on the shutter.** A big black head fills half the frame; cream eyes dart left and right; brows drop. *Fits content like:* "Semua toko sudah tutup"; a sold-out item; a missed deadline; a locked door in a mystery.
- **One window still lit.** The figure turns, the camera trucks past a dark lamppost, light spills from a shop window. *Fits content like:* a late-night shop; an app that answers at 2 a.m.; the one teacher who replies; the clue in a story.
- **Across the counter.** A second figure hands the object over; both smile; the caption carries the hours or price. *Fits content like:* "Lentera buka sampai jam sebelas"; a pharmacy's night shift; a tailor's quick fix; a gift handed over.
- **Holding it outside.** The figure hugs the object under the lamp and looks at us while the card settles. *Fits content like:* a bookshop's name and hours; a bakery's late batch; a course's sign-up; a story's warm ending.

## 8. Pitfalls

- A glossy, shaded or realistic head: keep it flat matte black with a thin amber rim on one side only.
- Big eyes with irises, or a talking mouth: small cream eyes, a short line mouth that changes only with the feeling.
- Daylight colours or a pale brand turning the night bright: the sets are look tokens; only the hoodie and props take the brand.
- Light from nowhere: every amber area has a source in frame (a lamp, a window, a door).
- Captions in a box, captions that flash word by word, or small captions: phrases in big outlined caps, the spoken word in amber.
- Several actions in one shot: one action and one reaction, then cut.

# Noir stickman: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2.6, medium 3.0, long 3.6.

## hook

- en: a wide night street, the hooded figure walks toward a lamp and slumps; slow push; a big caps caption lit word by word
- id: jalan malam lebar, tokoh berhoodie berjalan ke arah lampu lalu lesu; dorongan pelan; teks besar menyala per kata

## problem

- en: a close-up of the black head before a closed shutter or door, cream eyes dart, brows drop; amber rim from one side
- id: dekat ke kepala hitam di depan rolling atau pintu tertutup, mata krem melirik, alis turun; pinggiran amber dari satu sisi

## fact

- en: one warm window or screen glows in the dark set; the figure turns to it and walks; layered truck, light spills on the floor
- id: satu jendela atau layar hangat menyala di set gelap; tokoh menoleh lalu berjalan ke sana; kamera menyamping berlapis

## step

- en: one action per shot under a pool of light: the figure opens, carries or hands over an object, hand on the prop
- id: satu aksi per shot di bawah kolam cahaya: tokoh membuka, membawa, atau menyerahkan benda, tangan menempel pada bendanya

## compare

- en: the same street dark then lit, cut on the figure's turn; the caption names each side in two short phrases
- id: jalan yang sama gelap lalu menyala, dipotong saat tokoh menoleh; teks menyebut tiap sisi dalam dua frasa pendek

## number

- en: a clock, a receipt or a sign glowing amber in the dark, the figure looks at it; the number is the lit word of the caption
- id: jam, struk, atau papan yang menyala amber di gelap, tokoh menatapnya; angkanya jadi kata yang menyala di teks

## proof

- en: a warm interior two-shot: another figure smiles and nods, the hero's mouth opens in a grin; slow push
- id: dua tokoh di dalam ruangan hangat: tokoh lain tersenyum mengangguk, mulut si tokoh terbuka girang; dorongan pelan

## offer

- en: across a lit counter an object changes hands, both smile; the caption carries the hours or the price
- id: di atas konter yang terang benda berpindah tangan, keduanya tersenyum; teks membawa jam buka atau harganya

## cta

- en: outside the lit shop, the figure holds the object and looks at us; a name card in the second surface settles, held 2 s
- id: di depan toko yang terang, tokoh memegang bendanya dan menatap kita; kartu nama di permukaan kedua diam terbaca 2 detik

## payoff

- en: a quiet wide night frame, the figure small under a lamp, one closing caption held 2 s; slow pull back
- id: bingkai malam yang tenang, tokoh kecil di bawah lampu, satu kalimat penutup diam 2 detik; mundur pelan
